name: gap-project-config
about: 项目级配置 <项目>/.pilotdeck/pilotdeck.yaml（pilot/config/loadPilotConfig.ts:85-105，项目层优先于用户层）：alpha 项目的配置把 agent.model 改成 second 并改 maxOutputTokens；同一服务里默认项目的会话仍用用户配置。比较两边各一轮发给 provider 的请求（model、max_tokens）与 describe_project。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
        second:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 4096
telemetry:
  enabled: false
